treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Stratum I: Patients with recurrent medulloblastoma with measurable disease

role_evidence.quote: PEP-CMV is a vaccine mixture of a peptide referred to as Component A.

agents.drug_class_hint: CMV pp65 synthetic long peptide vaccine in Montanide ISA 51
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: targeting CMV antigens as an immunotherapeutic approach

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive standard chemotherapy with temozolomide for five days, followed by the study vaccine, PEP-CMV, on day 21.
Immunotherapy begins with a Td pre-conditioning vaccine (Td 1 Lf, in 0.4 mL of saline)

agents.drug_class_hint: Td vaccine used as preconditioning to prime the immune response to the peptide vaccine

coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (3-39 y; stdAges CHILD, ADULT) trial with three strata: recurrent medulloblastoma, newly diagnosed HGG (stratum II, closed; glioblastoma named only in the inclusion criteria list), newly diagnosed DIPG. Coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named; basket arguable because medulloblastoma is also eligible. Td vaccine is a priming vaccine, coded excluded_intervention_type (vaccine) though it could also be read as supportive; no candidate either way.
